AVIC International Holding Corporation.desc: Chinese company whose business, as the UK register of overseas companies states it, is international aviation, trade and logistics, and real estate and hotel management, from an address in Chaoyang District, Beijing; the same register records its former name as China National Aero-Technology Import & Export Corporation, to 25 October 2010. A Hong Kong Stock Exchange circular of 25 October 2019 calls it a limited liability company established in the PRC and the holding company and a controlling shareholder of the Hong Kong-listed AVIC International Holdings Limited.

Shanghai Municipal Engineering Design In.desc: Chinese design firm in Shanghai. Engineering News-Record's 2017 ranking of Chinese design firms placed it 12th by total design revenue, at $367.13 million; the list does not say which year that revenue covers.

Athi Water Works Development Agency.desc: Kenyan state water agency, one of the water works development agencies established by the Cabinet Secretary for Water and Sanitation under section 65(1) of the Water Act by Legal Notice 28 of 2019, with Nairobi, Kiambu and Murang'a counties as its area. Its own account of its mandate is the development, maintenance and management of national public water works, and operating them as a water service provider until the assets are handed over to a county provider.

China Gezhouba Group Corporation (CGGC).desc: Chinese water-conservancy, hydropower and large-infrastructure builder, grown out of the bureau that built the Gezhouba dam on the Yangtze from December 1970. China's Belt and Road Portal says it was listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 1997 and became an unlisted joint-stock company in 2021 after China Energy Engineering Corporation Limited (Energy China) acquired and merged it by share swap, and gives its revenue for 2020 as RMB 115 billion.
